services.desc: This Signature Cruise dives into our 2026 season and has been designed to show you the very best of the St. Lawrence River and the International Seaway as the river comes alive in the spring. Come and explore the passages and channels of the 1000 Islands and follow the majestic St. Lawrence into the heart of Montreal, passing through 7 seaway locks as you go. This cruise is 7 Nights and 8 Days at a special 6 Night rate.Learn more about this cruise These 4 night, 5 day cruises were created for those that want to deepen their knowledge of the history, geography, and culture of the 1000 Islands and St. Lawrence River. blurb: Guests cruise the St. Lawrence River aboard a classic Canadian riverboat, enjoying nature's northern scenery and historic attractions. Cruises explore intricate river channels and include shore tours to local attractions and excursions. The river is noted for its volume stability and natural beauty, forming a boundary between Canada and the United States.
